summary: Runs Python callbacks on project and runtime events such as process start, frame start/end, play state changes, device changes, and node creation.

key_params.name: active
key_params.note: Enable or disable all Execute DAT callbacks

key_params.name: executeloc
key_params.note: Choose the operator context scripts execute from

key_params.name: fromop
key_params.note: Operator context used when Execute From is set to Specified Operator

key_params.name: start
key_params.note: Run onStart when TouchDesigner starts

key_params.name: create
key_params.note: Run create when the node is created

key_params.name: exit
key_params.note: Run onExit when the TouchDesigner process quits

key_params.name: framestart
key_params.note: Run onFrameStart at the start of every frame

key_params.name: frameend
key_params.note: Run onFrameEnd at the end of every frame

key_params.name: playstatechange
key_params.note: Run when timeline play state changes

key_params.name: devicechange
key_params.note: Run when devices are connected or disconnected

key_params.name: edit
key_params.note: Open an editor to edit the Execute DAT text

key_params.name: file
key_params.note: Filesystem path for loading callback script text

key_params.name: syncfile
key_params.note: Synchronize the DAT text with the file on disk

key_params.name: loadonstart
key_params.note: Reload the file from disk when the project starts

key_params.name: loadonstartpulse
key_params.note: Instantly reload the file from disk

key_params.name: write

key_params.name: writepulse

key_params.name: language
key_params.note: Common DAT script-language setting

key_params.name: extension
key_params.note: External editor extension exposed by the DAT

key_params.name: customext

key_params.name: wordwrap
key_params.note: Common DAT node-display word wrap setting

common_gotchas: Frame callbacks can run every frame, so generated scripts need cheap guards and no unbounded side effects.
Start and Create callbacks trigger in numbered-alphanumeric Execute DAT name order when multiple Execute DATs exist.
Start callbacks are not called in TouchEngine, so tool plans need alternate initialization when targeting TouchEngine.
The input text is not editable; edit the Execute DAT text body or synced file instead.
Sync File can overwrite or write to disk, so automated edits should avoid enabling it accidentally.
key_concepts: Runs project and timeline callbacks such as start, create, exit, frame start, and frame end.
Can also react to play-state and device-change events when the corresponding toggles are enabled.
Execute-location parameters choose the operator context used for callback execution.
The File page can load, sync, and write callback script text on disk.
